investigations.name: mapk-signalling
investigations.title: MAPK signalling as a Bigraphical Reactive System
investigations.question:
Can the MAPK signalling cycle be expressed as a Milner-style Bigraphical
Reactive System and reproduce, under Gillespie SSA, the spatial signalling
behaviour of the prior live demo — MEK·ERK complex formation and phospho-ERK
translocation into the nucleus?
investigations.hypothesis:
A single time-stepped BRS process firing seven redex→reactum rewrite rules
over a nested cell bigraph reproduces the qualitative MAPK cycle: complexes
form in the cytoplasm and phospho-ERK accumulates in the nucleus over the run.
